name: customers
definition: 购买或使用企业产品与服务、并在交易系统中以唯一客户编号标识的个人或组织。 Counterexample: 与加油站区分：加油站是提供加油服务的场所实体，客户是消费主体；与交易区分：交易是客户在某一时点发生的购买事件。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table customers; provenance: direct source customers

name: gasstations
definition: 隶属于某一连锁品牌、位于特定国家并面向客户提供燃油及相关服务的固定经营场所。 Counterexample: 与客户区分：加油站是服务提供场所而非消费主体；与产品区分：产品是可售卖标的物，加油站是销售发生地。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table gasstations; provenance: direct source gasstations

name: products
definition: 由企业提供、以唯一产品编号标识并可在交易中被购买的商品或服务项目。 Counterexample: 与交易区分：产品是被购买对象，交易是购买行为本身；与加油站区分：产品是标的物，加油站是销售场所。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table products; provenance: direct source products

name: transactions
definition: 客户在某一时点于某加油站购买某产品并记录金额与单价的销售事件。 Counterexample: 与客户区分：交易是时点上发生的事件，客户是持续存在的消费主体；与产品区分：交易是购买行为，产品是被购买标的物。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table transactions_1k; provenance: direct source transactions_1k

name: yearmonth
definition: 按客户与月份汇总其消费金额形成的信息记录，用于反映客户在特定月份的消费总量。 Counterexample: 与交易区分：交易是逐笔发生的销售事件，月度消费汇总是对多笔交易聚合后的信息记录，不表示单次购买行为。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table yearmonth; provenance: direct source yearmonth

name: CzechRepublicGasStation
definition: Gas stations located in the Czech Republic.
aliases: gas stations in the Czech Republic

name: SlovakiaGasStation
definition: Gas stations located in Slovakia.

name: DiscountGasStation
definition: Gas stations whose segment is 'Discount'.

name: PremiumGasStation
definition: Gas stations whose segment is 'Premium'.

name: EURCustomer
definition: Customers whose currency is EUR.

name: CZKCustomer
definition: Customers whose currency is CZK.

name: SMECustomer
definition: Customers belonging to the SME segment.

name: TransactionAmount
definition: Number of items in a transaction.

name: TransactionPrice
definition: Price of a single item in a transaction.

name: TransactionDate
definition: Date on which a transaction occurred.

name: TransactionTime
definition: Time at which a transaction occurred.

name: YearMonthConsumption
definition: Monthly gas consumption per customer.

name: YearMonthDate
definition: Year-month identifier in the yearmonth table.

name: EURtoCZKCustomerRatio
definition: Ratio of customers paying in EUR to customers paying in CZK. Formula: EURCustomer / CZKCustomer. Inputs: EURCustomer = customers.CustomerID WHERE Currency = 'EUR'; CZKCustomer = customers.CustomerID WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
aliases: ratio of EUR to CZK customers

name: SMECZKminusEUR
definition: Difference between SMEs paying in CZK and SMEs paying in EUR. Formula: SMECustomer (CZK) - SMECustomer (EUR). Inputs: SMECustomer = customers.CustomerID WHERE Segment = 'SME'; CZKCustomer = customers.CustomerID WHERE Currency = 'CZK'; EURCustomer = customers.CustomerID WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
aliases: more SMEs pay in CZK than EUR
difference in SMEs paying CZK vs EUR

name: ConsumptionDifferenceCZKvsEUR2012
definition: Difference in total gas consumption in 2012 between CZK-paying and EUR-paying customers. Formula: SUM(YearMonthConsumption for CZK customers in 2012) - SUM(YearMonthConsumption for EUR customers in 2012). Inputs: YearMonthConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; CZKCustomer = customers.CustomerID WHERE Currency = 'CZK'; EURCustomer = customers.CustomerID WHERE Currency = 'EUR'; YearMonthDate = yearmonth.Date
aliases: difference in gas consumption between CZK and EUR customers

name: PremiumPercentageSVK
definition: Percentage of premium gas stations among all gas stations in Slovakia. Formula: PremiumGasStation (SVK) / COUNT(GasStationID) (SVK) * 100. Inputs: PremiumGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Segment = 'Premium'; SlovakiaGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Country = 'SVK'

name: DiscountStationDifferenceCZEminusSVK
definition: Difference in number of discount gas stations between Czech Republic and Slovakia. Formula: DiscountGasStation (CZE) - DiscountGasStation (SVK). Inputs: DiscountGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Segment = 'Discount'; CzechRepublicGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Country = 'CZE'; SlovakiaGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Country = 'SVK'
aliases: more discount stations in CZE than SVK
difference in discount stations CZE vs SVK
discount station difference cz eminus svk

name: TransactionsCZE20120826_8to9
definition: Number of transactions in Czech Republic on 2012-08-26 between 8:00 and 9:00. Formula: COUNT(TransactionID) WHERE Country='CZE' AND Date='2012-08-26' AND Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'. Inputs: CzechRepublicGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Country = 'CZE'; TransactionDate = transactions_1k.Date; TransactionTime = transactions_1k.Time

name: TopSpendingCustomer
definition: Customer with the highest total spending. Formula: CustomerID with MAX(SUM(TransactionPrice * TransactionAmount)). Inputs: TransactionPrice = transactions_1k.Price; TransactionAmount = transactions_1k.Amount

name: CountriesOfGasStationsJune2013
definition: List of countries where gas stations had transactions in June 2013. Formula: DISTINCT Country FROM gasstations JOIN transactions_1k WHERE Date LIKE '201306%'. Inputs: TransactionDate = transactions_1k.Date; CzechRepublicGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Country = 'CZE'; SlovakiaGasStation = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE Country = 'SVK'
aliases: countries of gas stations with transactions in June 2013

name: PercentageCustomersConsumedMoreThan528_3_Feb2012
definition: Percentage of customers with consumption > 528.3 in February 2012. Formula: COUNT(CustomerID WHERE Consumption > 528.3 AND Date='201202') / COUNT(CustomerID WHERE Date='201202') * 100. Inputs: YearMonthConsumption = yearmonth.Consumption; YearMonthDate = yearmonth.Date
aliases: percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3 in Feb 2012
percentage customers consumed more than 528 3 feb 2012

name: Country
definition: Countries where gas stations are located.

name: Segment
definition: Segments of gas stations or customers.

name: Currency
definition: Currencies used by customers.
